semantics: Each floor names an observable condition, expressed as answer-pattern predicates over tree question ids (question ids are declared per tree; the floors grader binds each predicate to the tree's declared bindings map, so trees can evolve wording while floors stay stable). For any path whose collected answers match a floor at or beyond applies_age_months_gte (corrected age where applicable), the terminal class must be at least min_class. Class order: typical_range < discuss < priority_discuss. A tree that can route a floor-matching path to a class below min_class fails compilation. Trees may exceed floors; they may never undercut them.

global_floors.rationale: The always_asked skill-loss node exists in every tree; a yes answer must reach priority_discuss in every domain, no exceptions.

Policy floor enforced by copy grader: every typical_range terminal must contain the standing invitation to raise it with the pediatrician anyway. Caregiver concern has real predictive validity and the tool's reassurance must never read as a door closing.

talking.rationale: No spontaneous two-word phrases by 24 months. Memorized chunks (all done, thank you) do not count; the question's help text must draw this line.
Unfamiliar adults understanding less than half of speech at 3 years and beyond warrants evaluation; intelligibility expectations rise steeply across this range.

understanding.rationale: Shared with hearing domain; the action sheet must route to both developmental and audiology conversations.
Not looking where a caregiver points by 18 months flags joint attention and receptive development.
Mirrors the LMC receptive floor so the two tools can never disagree at the red line.

walking_movement.rationale: Not sitting without support by 9 months.
Not bearing weight on legs when supported by 12 months.
Not walking independently by 18 months. Corrected age applies; the tree must surface the corrected-age note on this path.

Strong hand preference before 12 months is the inverted floor in this file: the concern is presence early, not absence late. It can signal weakness on the non-preferred side. applies_age_months_lt bounds it.
One-sided weakness, persistent asymmetric movement, or using one side of the body notably less, at any age.

hands_fine_motor.rationale: Not reaching for objects by 6 months.
Hands persistently fisted at 6 months; typical resolution is by roughly 4 months, floor set past the settled bound.
Not moving objects hand to hand by 9 months.
Not picking up small food items between thumb and finger by 12 months, phrased in the tree as the food-pickup observable rather than the term pincer grasp.

play.rationale: No back-and-forth social games (peekaboo, pat-a-cake style exchanges) by 12 months.
No simple pretend (feeding a doll, phone to ear) by 30 months, the outer bound of the settled range.

social_eye_contact.rationale: Not smiling in response to people by 4 months.
Not looking to a caregiver to share interest or enjoyment by 12 months, the joint-attention observable.
Mirrors the LMC floor exactly, same id, so the routing handoff can never produce contradictory severities.
Shared floor with understanding and hearing domains.

hearing_responding.rationale: Hearing is the exception domain: caregiver concern alone warrants audiological referral at any age, full stop. There is no watch-and-wait branch for hearing, and the action sheet leads with audiology, not the pediatric script.
No response to loud sounds at any age, with the action sheet noting newborn hearing screen results are a point-in-time test and do not rule out later loss.
Not turning toward sounds or voices by 9 months.
Third appearance of this floor by design: whichever door the parent walks through, the same observation hits the same red line.

behavior_regulation.rationale: Restated here despite the global floor because this domain's tree is the most judgment-heavy and must not rely on inheritance alone.
Repeated self-injurious behavior (head banging beyond brief tantrum context, biting self to marks) at any age.

Policy note: behavior and regulation lacks crisp published red-line ages compared to other domains. Floors here are deliberately minimal rather than falsely precise; the tree carries the conservatism through its always-ask framing and generous discuss routing instead. Do not invent numeric floors this literature does not support.
